intent: IMPLEMENT ReactorTelemetryStreamGateway so the frozen test passes; Java 17, Spring Boot 3, non-blocking, no cross-context domain imports, no hardcoded config values. Spec: Telemetry Stream Broadcasting adapter implementing TelemetryStreamGateway. Constructor ReactorTelemetryStreamGateway(int subscriberBuffer>0). Backed by Sinks.many().multicast().directBestEffort(); publish emits non-blocking (no subscribers or slow subscribers never block or fail the publisher); items() = sink.asFlux().onBackpressureBuffer(subscriberBuffer, BufferOverflowStrategy.DROP_OLDEST) so each subscriber's demand is respected with bounded memory.
